props.title: 1. Develop
props.content: Run locally against a personal Convex dev deployment. No pilot data, devices, or production secrets.

props.title: 2. Preview
props.content: PR gets a disposable Vercel URL with non-production configuration and fixtures.

props.title: 3. Staging
props.content: Deploy the reviewed develop commit to the isolated staging Convex targets and run real integration smoke tests.

props.title: 4. Production
props.content: Promote the accepted commit only after backup/restore proof and an explicit cutover approval.

props.label: Provider Gates
props.title: Core fleet identity is isolated; SuntiQ access routing is staged
Fleet: staging lane is live
props.content: SuntiQ Fleet Nonprod serves local, Preview, and persistent staging identities. The separate SuntiQ Fleet production app and certificate are ready but contain no pilot users.

props.title: Cloudflare: SuntiQ internal edge converged
props.content: Pulumi owns the healthy suntiq-control-01 tunnel, explicit crm/sign ingress, both DNS records, the SuntiQ Workspace IdP, CRM Access policies, and the Convex service token. crm requires SuntiQ Google SSO; sign remains public for external NDA recipients.

props.title: CRM automation credentials are live
props.content: The Cloudflare service token and a fresh Twenty API key are stored only in the SuntiQ website production Convex environment. A production Convex action reached Twenty through Access and created exactly one jp@suntiq.ai person record.

props.title: Legacy migration still needs Sunny
props.content: Production fleet data, identities, and device credentials remain blocked on legacy Convex/Clerk access or complete exports. Sunny also needs SuntiQ Vercel team access and a linked Git identity for deployments.

props.title: Destination DNS is publicly authoritative
props.content: After source-zone deletion, public DNS serves the destination Google MX/SPF, Vercel staging, and explicit CRM/sign tunnel records through eva/frank.cloudflare.com. No registrar or nameserver action remains; the destination wildcard stays absent.

props.title: Google and Resend authentication passed
props.content: DMARC report 310233935211785613 contains four messages: one aligned Google pass, one aligned Resend pass, and two ARC-preserved Google relays with DigitalOcean alignment failure. Keep p=none while the sample grows.

props.title: SuntiQ Cloudflare Access credential is ready
props.content: The SuntiQ Google Workspace IdP redirects through https://suntiq.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/callback and completes login as jp@suntiq.ai. Pulumi stores the OAuth secret encrypted and owns the CRM Access application and service policy.

props.title: Website OAuth reaches real providers
props.content: Nonprod and production Google/LinkedIn credentials are installed only in their matching Convex deployments. Staging Google completed provider consent, callback, session creation, and the protected welcome route. LinkedIn accepted the client, scopes, and staging callback and is waiting only for the operator to submit the existing LinkedIn login form. Vercel SSO protection was removed because it blocked public OAuth callbacks; Git-fork and skew protection remain enabled.

props.title: Nonprod and production auth projects are Pulumi-owned
props.content: Created protected projects suntiq-product-auth-nonprod (269615862755) and suntiq-product-auth-prod (539363790980). The post-apply preview reports sixteen unchanged resources across GCP and Cloudflare.

props.title: Yes, Kingly already used Google with Cloudflare Access
props.content: The downloaded client belongs to GCP project kingly-zero-trust and authorizes https://kingly-studio.cloudflareaccess.com. It confirms the pattern, but the credential must not be reused for SuntiQ.

items.title: Staging Convex boundaries created
items.description: Created SuntiQ website and fleet staging projects with dedicated production-class deployments.

items.title: Website staging deployed cleanly
items.description: Website functions, Better Auth component, schema, and indexes are deployed with zero migrated records.

items.title: Preview isolation corrected
items.description: The website Preview deploy key no longer points to Kingly production Convex.

items.title: Live operator tracker established
items.description: The single local /now tracker is the ongoing progress surface and is configured to refresh every five minutes.

items.title: Clerk environment matrix completed
items.description: Provisioned separate local/Preview, persistent staging, and production Clerk instances. Production is fleet-scoped at fleet.suntiq.ai with clerk.fleet.suntiq.ai, verified DNS/certificates, matching Vercel/Convex bindings, and no stale root Clerk CNAMEs.

items.title: Fleet staging deployed
items.description: Deployed the Fleet schema/functions to successful-fennec-587 and the Vercel staging application to fleet-staging.suntiq.ai.

items.title: Mail records and tunnel migration staged
items.description: Workspace and Resend records were exported/imported. The imported wildcard still targets the legacy tunnel and must be replaced with explicit SuntiQ tunnel records without touching the live pilot.

items.title: DocuSeal routed and rebranded
items.description: sign.suntiq.ai is live alongside the old URL and a secret-protected staging webhook runs in parallel. Resend SMTP authentication works; hello@suntiq.ai and internal@suntiq.ai are both real vendor-facing Workspace recipients.

items.title: Website staging and restore proof completed
items.description: staging.suntiq.ai is live on the custom Vercel staging lane. The encrypted off-host backup restored DocuSeal with SQLite integrity OK and Twenty with 83 user tables.

items.title: Convex production baselines backed up
items.description: Completed manual tables-only backups for giant-eagle-527 and insightful-kookabura-350. They expire in seven days; automatic recurring backups require a higher Convex plan.

items.title: Fresh SuntiQ CRM isolated
items.description: The independent Twenty stack is live behind SuntiQ Workspace Access. A fresh API key plus Cloudflare service token are installed in production suntiq-www Convex, and the Convex-to-Twenty upsert path is verified.

items.title: Website NDA allowlist rebranded locally
items.description: Replaced the Kingly/Argo NDA auto-activation literals and local mail defaults with SuntiQ values. ESLint and TypeScript pass; the change is not deployed until it follows the reviewed promotion path.

items.title: SuntiQ Google consent and infrastructure source prepared
items.description: The internal Google Auth Platform consent flow completed. The isolated Suntiq-Inc/suntiq-infra repository contains the reviewed keyless GitHub OIDC and guarded Cloudflare control-plane source.

items.title: SuntiQ-owned Pulumi identity stack applied
items.description: Suntiq/suntiq-platform owns the keyless GitHub Actions deploy identity. The post-apply preview reports seven unchanged resources.

items.title: DNS, Kingly OAuth, and DMARC downloads audited
items.description: Confirmed the DNS import source, found the legacy wildcard tunnel target, proved the downloaded OAuth client belongs to Kingly, and verified aligned Google/Resend traffic in the first DMARC report.

items.title: SuntiQ Access client created and destination wildcard removed
items.description: Verified the new Google client belongs to suntiq-infrastructure with the exact Cloudflare Access origin/callback. Jean-Patrick manually removed *.suntiq.ai from the destination tenant.

items.title: OAuth secret encrypted and product-auth projects applied
items.description: Pulumi securely stored the internal Google credential, moved ADC quota off Kingly, and created protected nonprod/production product-auth projects. Post-apply preview is nine unchanged.

items.title: SuntiQ destination DNS is now public
items.description: Pulumi imported suntiq-control-01 and sign.suntiq.ai, created crm.suntiq.ai, and moved both explicit records to the SuntiQ tunnel. CRM returns the Access challenge and sign returns HTTP 200.

items.title: Website OAuth clients installed and Google E2E verified
items.description: Installed nonprod Google in local/dev and staging, both nonprod providers in staging, and both production providers in production without exposing their values. Rebuilt staging against striped-malamute-687, removed conflicting Vercel SSO protection, and completed Google consent, callback, session, and protected-route proof as jp@suntiq.ai.

items.title: Complete LinkedIn callback, then run NDA/CRM smoke
items.description: Submit the handed-off LinkedIn login form, verify the callback creates a valid staging session, then exercise NDA signing, email delivery, and the Convex-to-Twenty contact path before preparing the apex production deployment.
